title: Logistics Coordinator
description: Official Alkaffary Group logistics role in Riyadh focused on coordinating supply-chain flow from sourcing to delivery. The role covers shipment tracking, supplier, transporter, and client communication, logistics-performance analysis, inventory oversight, order fulfillment, shipment documentation and compliance, and coordination with warehousing and transportation teams. The role asks for a bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field, plus at least 2 years of logistics or supply-chain experience.
